subject: general
question: ___________ is a process associated with increasing openness, growing economic interdependence and deepening economic integration in the world economy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Globalisation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Globalization** is the word used to narrate the growing interdependence of the world's** economies, arts, and populations, conduct regarding by cross-border trade in goods and services, technology, and flows of investment, people, and details.**
 
• The wide-ranging results of globalization are **multiplex and politically charged.**
 
• Countries have to **construct economic cooperation** to facilitate these movements over many centuries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Privatization is **the procedure of transferring an enterprise or industry from the public section to the private section**.
 
• Nationalization is **the procedure of taking privately-controlled companies, industries, or benefits and putting them under the authority of the government**.
 
• The two important motives of liberalisation in India were: **To raise foreign direct investment, industrial production, and technological competitiveness on a global scale**.
